\definecolor{ekznwOlive}{HTML}{495C3F}
\definecolor{ekznwBrown}{HTML}{554838}
\definecolor{ekznwAccent}{HTML}{8B4513}
\definecolor{ekznwCream}{HTML}{E2DFD0}
\setkomafont{title}{\sffamily\bfseries\color{ekznwOlive}\LARGE}
\setkomafont{subtitle}{\sffamily\color{ekznwBrown}\large}
\setkomafont{section}{\sffamily\bfseries\color{ekznwOlive}\large}
\setkomafont{subsection}{\sffamily\bfseries\color{ekznwBrown}\normalsize}
\setkomafont{pageheadfoot}{\sffamily\footnotesize\color{ekznwBrown}}

\setlength{\emergencystretch}{3em}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.18}

% Reference-style hanging indent: the first line remains on the text margin,
% while continuation lines are inset by 1.5em.
\newenvironment{citationhang}{%
  \begin{list}{}{%
    \setlength{\leftmargin}{1.5em}%
    \setlength{\rightmargin}{0pt}%
    \setlength{\itemindent}{-1.5em}%
    \setlength{\labelwidth}{0pt}%
    \setlength{\labelsep}{0pt}%
    \setlength{\topsep}{0pt}%
    \setlength{\partopsep}{0pt}%
    \setlength{\parsep}{0pt}%
    \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}%
  }%
  \item[]%
}{\end{list}}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\maketitle}{%
  \thispagestyle{plain}%
  \noindent\colorbox{ekznwCream}{%
    \parbox{\dimexpr\linewidth-2\fboxsep\relax}{%
      \vspace{4mm}\hspace{4mm}%
      \begin{minipage}[c]{23mm}
        \includegraphics[width=21mm]{ekznw-theme/style/img/corplogo120.png}
      \end{minipage}\hspace{4mm}%
      \begin{minipage}[c]{\dimexpr\linewidth-38mm\relax}
        {\small\color{ekznwBrown} EZEMVELO KZN WILDLIFE\par}
        \vspace{2mm}{\usekomafont{title}\@title\par}
        \ifx\@subtitle\@empty\else\vspace{2mm}{\usekomafont{subtitle}\@subtitle\par}\fi
      \end{minipage}\par\vspace{4mm}%
    }}\par\vspace{5mm}%
  \ifx\@author\@empty\else{\small\@author\par}\fi
  \ifx\@date\@empty\else{\small\color{ekznwBrown}\@date\par}\fi
  \vspace{4mm}%
}
\makeatother
